set.body:
Purpose

Make the reset subtract before it adds. Audit every export and retain it only when an exported workflow consumes it or a hard declared scale regime is enforced.

Acceptance

- Normalizer, transform, reducer, connectivity, and tomography exports each have a public end-to-end reachability test or are de-exported.
- The private .evaluate_edge_operation path is removed if no surviving public workflow executes it.
- Pure algebra files that call no package code no longer count as product certification; their useful laws drive exported product-oracle tests.
- Connectivity/tomography are either explicitly small-node with hard resource preflight or internal until scale-qualified.
- NAMESPACE, Rd, vignettes, and README describe only executable surfaces.
- The reset records deleted exports, code, and tests as a subtraction receipt.

This epic does not change the evidence-pairing mathematics or implement new statistics.
set.title: Epic 0A: Subtract unreachable public and test surface
